newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak VSZ postpones Trinec agreement.
newsitem.headline: Slovak VSZ postpones Trinec agreement.

text.p: Slovak steel maker VSZ a.s. on Monday said it had postponed the signing of a cooperation contract Czech Trinecke Zelezarny scheduled for Tuesday.

"The cooperation contract will not be signed tomorrow due to a enormoulsy busy management schedule and no agreement has been reached with Trinec on a new signing date," VSZ spokesman Ladislav Jakubec told Reuters.
He declined further comment on the issue.
It is the second time the long-expected signing had been postponed, spurring speculation that VSZ was interested in buying a major stake in Trinec.
VSZ has denied the rumours, but industry analysts remain unconvinced, saying some type of merger between the two firms makes sense.

"Mere cooperation has neither rhyme nor reason unless equity-bound, and I think VSZ is waiting with the contract until it has accumulated a large share in Trinec," Vladimir Kuklis, an analyst with CSOB Bank Bratislava, told Reuters.
Jozef Cimra, an analyst at ING Barings, added VSZ appears to be waiting for better conditions for the contract.
"VSZ appears quite self-confident about a Trinec acquisition," he said.
Bratislava stock market brokers said they had not noticed any significant trades with Trinec shares.
